result.title: Unified Loss-Aware Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: The efficiency and fidelity of 3D Gaussian Splatting critically depend on adaptive density control, which grows and suppresses Gaussian primitives throughout optimization. However, the standard pipeline still relies on heuristic view-space gradients, scale thresholds, and global opacity resets, rather than explicitly assessing the loss-reducing effect of each split, clone, or opacity update. This mismatch can allocate primitives to already-sufficient regions, miss under-reconstructed structures, and destabilize training through blanket opacity changes. In this work, we recast adaptive density control as a collection of local loss-reduction decisions. We derive efficient Taylor-based per-Gaussian surrogates that predict the objective change caused by three primitive-level operations: splitting, cloning, and opacity decay. This yields a unified loss-aware framework with three components. First, we extend second-order splitting to a normalized joint position-scale space, enabling children to adapt not only their locations but also their anisotropic extents. Second, we formulate duplicate cloning as a surrogate minimization problem, selecting only Gaussians whose duplicated contribution is predicted to improve reconstruction and assigning each child a principled opacity. Third, we replace global opacity reset with selective soft opacity decay that weakens harmful primitives while preserving useful ones. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our method produces more targeted primitive allocation and achieves improved rendering quality with comparable or smaller Gaussian budgets compared to baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的自适应密度控制重构为一系列局部损失下降决策，用 Taylor 展开为分裂、克隆与不透明度衰减三种原语级操作推导高效的逐高斯代理目标，并据此选择性分配与削弱高斯原语。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按预测目标变化决定是否新增、复制或衰减表示单元」的思路，可能为 latent 推理中推理步或 latent 状态的增删与贡献分配提供可核查的代理目标设计线索，但属于 3D 渲染领域，迁移性需较多核查。
